text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Cover it with soil, and I'm all done.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Phew... I think I broke a sweat. Now's a
good time
for a break.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Warm sunshine...
The smell of fresh soil...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Just like that, Nishino Flower falls into
blissful
sleep and misses her training
session.
